title: neyraudia mezii
intro: Neyraudia mezii, commonly known as the Himalayan sweet grass or Nepal reed, is a species of grass native to the Himalayan region. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The health benefits of Neyraudia mezii are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which have been identified in various studies.
